evidence.title: Prompt Engineering 101. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: Prompt Engineering 101
summary: Paid newsletter post with six rules for prompting today's LLMs, from dropping "step-by-step" to capping rules at three.
description: An instalment of the How to AI newsletter arguing that prompting techniques from 2023 papers are outdated for current Claude and ChatGPT models. The outline: never end with "right?", forget the "step-by-step", do not trust confidence, stick to 3 rules max, goals over examples, and "The One Prompt". The full text is for paid subscribers.
